directory_setting.owner: LLD-04 semantic registry over LLD-02 settings persistence
directory_setting.default_state: unset with UI suggestion of the current Windows Downloads directory; suggestion is never silently persisted or searched when unset
rules: one directory is shared by RFC and WFM automatic discovery
directory value must be an absolute local path selected/reviewed by the operator
automatic discovery inspects direct entries only
missing/inaccessible directory fails truthfully and never broadens search

filename_matcher.collision_suffix: optional final Windows-style space + '(' + positive decimal integer + ')' before .xlsx; suffix is physical-name disambiguation only
filename_matcher.matching: case-sensitive Unicode code-point exact matching after filesystem name retrieval; no trim/fuzzy/substrings/wildcard family guessing
filename_matcher.registry_rule: the adapter compiles this declarative profile to one anchored full-filename matcher; profile/version and compiled matcher golden fixtures are release data and cannot change in place

candidate_chronology.meaning: discovery ranking only; never RFC business/source chronology
rules: collision suffix numeric magnitude is not chronology
copying an old workbook may rank it as a discovery candidate but does not make contained RFC facts operationally new

profiles.manual_selection: may select another local .xlsx file explicitly; manual selection still requires this source profile's workbook/header/content validation but does not require automatic-discovery filename eligibility

embedded_timestamp.position: after the exact family marker and before optional collision suffix/extension
embedded_timestamp.validation: strict calendar validity; no normalization of malformed components

filename_matcher.collision_suffix: optional final Windows-style space + '(' + positive decimal integer + ')' before .xlsx; suffix is physical-name disambiguation only
filename_matcher.matching: case-sensitive exact family-marker/grammar matching; no fuzzy/substrings/wildcard family guessing
filename_matcher.registry_rule: the adapter compiles this declarative profile to one anchored full-filename matcher; profile/version and compiled matcher golden fixtures are release data and cannot change in place

rules: invalid/missing supported timestamp makes an automatic candidate malformed
filesystem mtime never substitutes for invalid WFM embedded chronology
collision suffix magnitude is not chronology

profiles.manual_selection: manual source selection remains allowed but still requires a usable supported source chronology under the profile; manual selection does not silently substitute filesystem mtime

classification_rules: a direct file may classify into at most one source family
automatic discovery excludes files that match neither exact profile
ambiguous multi-profile classification is a registry integrity failure and no candidate is selected
symbolic links/reparse traversal/nonregular files never become candidates
candidate ranking is deterministic and selecting the highest-ranked candidate occurs before workbook parsing; a selected malformed workbook fails visibly with no older fallback
profile_evolution: A filename/header/timezone/vocabulary grammar change creates a new immutable profile/version. Historical ImportRuns retain the exact profile_id and registry versions used.
